rv.q: This is a group moving perfectly in concert, as elegantly balanced as dancers.

This is a subtle and lively version of one of Shakespeare's greatest comedies, full of light, laughter and love.
This fresh, gently moving production, packed with wonderful performances and keenly observant about the universal need for love and acceptance.

This is a wonderfully enjoyable, fun and excellently staged As It — and one that reminds you just how entertaining Shakespeare can be.

cn.t: Jonathan Groff leads a joyous, inventive all-male production that critics find radiant and witty, though some question whether the casting choice fully justifies itself. The RSC staging earns widespread praise for its charm and ensemble work.

vr.q: I would encourage all of you to go and see this for yourselves.
